messages:
marie: Quick shout — PraxisEDU just went live with their AI Grader built on Redwood Private (VPC + KMS). Pilot -> paid annual in 48h, 🎉 https://redwood.example.com/case/praxisedu-launch

suresh: 🙌 wild. They required customer-managed KMS + SSO (SAML) and strict audit logs, right?

marie: Correct. Legal signed the SOC2 addendum, infra stood up the private control plane, and we shipped an HSM-backed key config overnight.

andre: Huge props to eng-ml — we served them a quantized MPT-7B variant with optimized kernels and a fallback to a smaller model during peaks. Cost down ~40% vs baseline.

jenna: Sales update: initial commit is $120k ARR with paid onboarding and premium SLA. Marking as Edu Strategic in CRM.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: praxisedu-private-vpc v1.0.0 — 1763890300

marie: Marketing/comms: case study draft will be in #marketing tomorrow. Want a short quote from Praxis product lead; they approved a joint press blurb.

suresh: Can we include a short technical callout about prefix caching and per-route observability? They liked the per-route token cost breakdown.

andre: I'll add perf numbers for the case study: p50 gen latency 120ms, p95 280ms, sustained throughput 45 req/s on the reserved pool. Also note automatic KV cache warmup reduced cold-starts for grading batches.

jenna: @revenue-ops FYI — coordinating onboarding invoices and success milestones.

marie: Tiny ask: internal newsletter blurb (1-2 lines + logo) — who can approve?

suresh: I can ok the blurb. put it here and I'll sign off.

marie: Blurb posted: 'PraxisEDU launches AI Grader with Redwood Private — pilot converted to paid in 48 hours; private VPC + customer KMS + SSO.'

andre: Love it. Closing loop on my side. Extra kudos to infra for the fast HSM setup. :tada:

jenna: Thanks everyone — great win for partnerships + product!
